name: agpr_mfma_pinning
description: Use __builtin_amdgcn_mfma_* + asm volatile('+v'(c)) for AGPR pinning, never '+a' asm
steps: Replace any '+a'(fp32x16) asm constraints with builtin MFMA intrinsics
Add asm volatile('' : '+v'(c)) barrier after each MFMA builtin call
Verify SNR >= 140 dB ('+a' drops to 21 dB from lost reg_idx=0)
expected_impact: correctness: 21 dB → 142 dB SNR, 170 AGPR utilization
